title_zh: 从落选反馈判断项目契合度

scenario.label_zh: 从落选反馈判断申请项目契合度
scenario.goal_zh: 区分计划声誉与申请契合度并决定先修改项目说明

context_zh: 写作学员 Eva 与导师 Miles 阅读虚构的研究资助落选反馈，不涉及真实申请或个人评估。
author: author-phase12-a

sentences.speaker: Eva
sentences.text: I thought a prestigious fellowship would be ideal, so this rejection really surprised me.

sentences.speaker: Miles
sentences.text: The feedback questions the relevance of your project to this year's theme. It doesn't say the writing is poor.

sentences.speaker: Eva
sentences.text: But the programme is run by a renowned historian whose work I love.

sentences.speaker: Miles
sentences.text: That explains your interest, but not how your project fits their theme.

sentences.speaker: Eva
sentences.text: You're right. I'll revise the project description before looking for another call.

sentences.speaker: Miles
sentences.text: Start with the question you want to answer. Then we can compare it with each programme's focus.
